What is JSG? (JustSomeGamers)

We're a gaming community that is much more simplified and gives members more freedom to control aspects of the group. (see points beleow)

The name is a play on words.

So I'm interested...

  • We are generally inclusive, no age restrictions (smart/mature kids are fun), no K/D requirements, and no events that require your attendance.
  • Members are free to make their own events and represent the community in different games. You go to what events interest you.
  • Our only requirement is that you follow the community Code:

jsg-code: membership requirements

  1. Value friends over games.

  2. Hop on Mumble when ingame.

Every member hops on Mumble while ingame. This is the primary way the community socializes. You can start up lobbies and start talking with whoever else is on immediately.

  • All members can create temp-channels for their own public and private lobbies.
  • We don't kick people for inactivity unless you are breaking code2 consistently.
  • If you are busy and don't want to talk with others, there's a Busy channel on Mumble.

Okay, how do I 'offically' join?

Just agree to follow the Code and do it. Of course you'll also have to get acquainted with the current members of the group on Mumble.

Anything else?

Q: Can I invite friends?

A: You can invite any of your friends as guests to Mumble and events. If they want to join just show them the Code and have them agree to it.

Q: How do I get Mumble?

A: Go to http://tinyurl.com/jsgftw

Q: How do I 'create' events?

A: Just make a thread in the event sub-forum (https://justsomegamers.com) with the date, time, what you're doing, and any conditions you want set for the event. Conditions like you must speak like a pirate or bring your own resources.

Q: Does JSG have any social media?

A: Voat is one of them. Here's the rest:

  • https://justsomegamers.com Forums and main site.

  • http://steamcommunity.com/groups/JustSomeGamers Event organization, Steam friends, and instant announcements.

  • https://reddit.com/r/JSG subreddit Sharing lots of pictures, video and doing reddit like things. (AMA's and voting threads)

  • https://twitter.com/JustSomeGamers_ For the latest news. The first place where you can find Town Hall recordings.

  • https://www.youtube.com/user/JSGCommunity Videos show-casing our community events or general things we do.

I think it's very clear that Obama hates payday loans, and I can't say I blame him. They are the very definition of predatory.

Why? While they frequently have much higher interest rates than traditional loans, the companies which give them out have very high interest on them in part because they are lending to people who a) default frequently and b) don't have any easy collateral. Now, one can argue that even given that the interest rates are higher than they should be (and I'd be inclined to agree with that argument), but that's very different than arguing that such businesses are by nature predatory.

I honestly used to agree with you on that. I definitely understand the higher interest rates, and no one is forcing these people to take them. However, I sit by a guy at work who uses payday loans. Somehow other companies get his number and he gets call after call from people trying to get him to use their company. They are definitely seeking people out.

Well, yeah. Businesses of all sorts seek people out. That's how you get new customers. Again, by itself that's not particularly predatory.

In this case, it is important to realize that the businesses are not inherently predatory because that means that we can (and should) rein them in with stricter legislation (right now there's close to zero oversight of the payday loan businesses) rather than try to get right of them outright (which also is much less likely to be successful).
Oh, I'm not saying get rid of them outright. They definitely do have a purpose.
